name: Na odnu noch'
source:
Imagine that you have spent your whole life dedicated to your career and finally reached the desired heights by taking the position of CEO. Now you have status and money, as well as friends and adorable pets. But there's something that keeps a person like you down. It's endlessly recurring erotic dreams.

How do you deal with that? After all, such a busy career man/woman like you do not need neither love, nor responsibility, nor long walks under the moon waiting for the first kiss. Well, we have the solution!

Install the app "Your Favorite Lovers" and spend the most unpredictable night in the company of a mysterious seducer.

But only one night.

[From [url=https://paleoginstudio.itch.io/one-nighter]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
想象一下，你一生都致力于自己的事业，最终达到了理想的高度，担任了首席执行官。现在你有了地位和金钱，还有朋友和可爱的宠物。但有些事情会让像你这样的人感到沮丧。这是无休止地重复出现的色情梦。

你如何处理这个问题？毕竟，像你这样忙碌的职业男女，既不需要爱，也不需要责任，也不需要在月下漫步等待初吻。好吧，我们有解决方案！

安装“你最喜欢的恋人”应用程序，在神秘诱惑者的陪伴下度过最难以预测的夜晚。

但只有一晚。

[来自[url=https://paleoginstudio.itch.io/one-nighter]Itch.io[/url]]
